## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Ourhomes?
Projects in Madipakkam, Adambakkam and Guindy, Chennai.

### What facilities does Ourhomes have?
2 & 3 BHK flats, Villas, Joint ventures, Customer login & dashboard, Home loan help, Vasthu tips, Madipakkam, Adambakkam, Guindy.

### Does Ourhomes do joint ventures?
Yes. Ourhomes considers land with a clean title, 1 to 5 grounds, a 30 ft or wider road and an approved site with patta, in areas such as Chrompet, Tambaram, Medavakkam, Pallikaranai, Sholinganallur and OMR.

### What is available now?
Beulah Residency (2 or 3 BHK flats, Madipakkam), December@Guindy (3 BHK / 2 BHK flats) and August Villa (villas in Kuberan Nagar, Madipakkam).

### How do I book a site visit with Ourhomes?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 95000 90305.
